question: what lends a unit standing on a friend's land in the first hours of a game

addresses.name: CEU3AI_HasPriorityProvinceInArea
addresses.comment: Walks the province ids of the AI's priority list (CEU3AI +0x118, rebuilt each pass by CEU3AI::RebuildPriorityProvinces) and answers true where one lies in the area (CMapProvince +0x2B4). `ret 8`. Called by CAIUnit::ManageExpeditions to let a unit be lent into land a human holds. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-balancing.md.
